Title: Erläuterung für Herrn Caspar Schwenckfeld, und die Zugethanen seiner Lehre, wegen vielen Stücken, beydes aus der Historie und Theologie; allen aufrichtigen Nachforschern und Liebhabern der Wahrheit zum Dienste ans Licht zu stellen (Zweyte Auflage)
Creator: 'Etliche der ehemaligen gottseligen Auswanderer aus Schlesien nach Pennsylvanien in Nord-Amerika' (the Schwenkfelder emigrant community; the host catalogue names Christopher Schultz, 1718-1789, as author); second edition revised by a committee of the community
Publisher: Sumneytown [Pennsylvania]: gedruckt bey E. Benner. First edition: Jauer, Lower Silesia, Heinrich Christian Müller, 1771, as the second edition's own Vorrede states
Publication Date: 1830
Rights: Public Domain (1830 imprint read on the title page in the OCR; public domain by date; host possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT)
Language: deu
Source: Internet Archive item erluterungfrher00schugoog, file erluterungfrher00schugoog_djvu.txt (New York Public Library copy, Google scan), fetched directly by the library/source-research thread (Era VII session, one-world agent for schwenckfelders), 2026-10-16; host rights statement: possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT (contributor New York Public Library).
Provenance note: Header prepended; Google's standard front notice (English and German, the first 142 lines of the OCR file, ending at the books.google.com line) stripped mechanically; long-s to s normalisation: 7456 occurrences replaced; the OCR text otherwise follows unchanged. Rights basis restated: an 1830 Pennsylvania imprint, read off the scanned title page, is public domain by date, and the host marks the item NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
Content note: The Schwenkfelders' own apologia and history, written in Pennsylvania and first printed in Silesia in 1771: a Vorbericht and a Vorrede zur zweyten Auflage (which says the second edition translated the first edition's Latin passages into German and clarified some sentences 'ohne den eigentlichen Sinn und Inhalt eines Schriftstellers zu ändern'), a chapter list (Capitel 1-11 with page numbers), then the chapters, headed 'Das 1. Capitel' and so on (the OCR loses some chapter heads), including 'Das 8. Capitel. Von Caspar Schwenckfelds Rechenschaft und Bekenntniß des christlichen Glaubens' and the history of the Silesian community through the persecution and emigration, closing with a deathbed account. Fraktur OCR sampled at five points: readable (whole-word share 0.83-0.92) with the usual Fraktur substitutions ('fie' for 'sie', 'Erläuterunge' for 'Erläuterungs'); quote only after checking the page images. The 1771 first edition was not found on any reachable host. No public-domain English translation was found.
